## cilium-dbg bpf crap update

Update CRAP entries

### Synopsis

Create/Update CRAP entry.

Usage: cilium bpf crap update <public_ip> <pod_ip> [port_begin] [port_end]

If port_begin and port_end are omitted, the full 0-65535 range is used.
If only port_begin is given, it applies to that single port.


```
cilium-dbg bpf crap update [flags]
```
